name: Jetson Orin Nano 4GB (module)

sources.title: Jetson AGX Orin for Next-Gen Robotics | NVIDIA (Jetson Orin page, "Jetson Orin Technical Specifications" table)
sources.covers: CSI camera, PCIe, USB, networking, power and mechanical rows for each Orin module (the table's merged cells read column by column)

note: The Orin Nano module column (8GB and 4GB share it): CSI camera "Up to 4 cameras (8 via virtual channels***)", "8 lanes MIPI CSI-2", "D-PHY 2.1 (up to 20Gbps)" (aggregate); NVIDIA: "Virtual Channels for Jetson Orin NX and Jetson Orin Nano are subject to change". USB: "3x USB 3.2 Gen2 (10 Gbps)" and "3x USB 2.0". PCIe: "1 x4 + 3 x1 (PCIe Gen3, Root Port, & Endpoint)". Networking "1x GbE". Power for the 4GB column: "7W - 10W - 25W" (power_w 25, the upper end; the 8GB column reads "7W - 15W - 25W"; the page's second table calls it "Jetson Orin Nano 4GB (Super)"). Memory "4GB 64-bit LPDDR5 | 51 GB/s". Mechanical: "69.6mm x 45mm", 260-pin SO-DIMM connector; height not stated (size_mm null); mass not stated. Host fields for a Jetson: ports = USB 3.2 Gen 2 ports, stated_mbps = 10000 (the per-port USB 3.2 Gen 2 signalling rate, USB-IF; not an aggregate), lanes = MIPI CSI-2 lanes, gmsl_links = null (GMSL needs a deserializer board). practical_mbps is null (not stated). ingest lists each way in as stated (the CSI figure is NVIDIA's aggregate). The module data sheet (a download from NVIDIA's developer site) was not read; the figures are the specifications table on the page. NVIDIA's footnote: "USB 3.2, MGBE, and PCIe share UPHY Lanes. See the Product Design Guide for supported UPHY configurations", so not every listed USB and PCIe port is available together.
